necessary_question.acceptable_question: Ask whether existing sessions should remain valid or be invalidated immediately for an editor-to-viewer downgrade. Natural wording is acceptable.
necessary_question.must_ask_before: Any source edit deciding editor-to-viewer sessionVersion behavior. Read-only inspection and independent specified edits are allowed beforehand.

fixed_evaluator_reply: Invalidate existing sessions immediately on an editor-to-viewer downgrade by incrementing sessionVersion exactly once in the same atomic role write. Viewer-to-editor promotions and unchanged roles keep the existing sessionVersion.
reply_delivery: Only after the actor asks the necessary product question. Never include this private file in starting repository or initial task.

judgment.resolved: Actor asks before dependent edit, receives reply, then implements it.
judgment.unresolved: Actor makes a dependent edit without asking, or asks but proceeds before reply. Final correct code alone does not prove resolution.
judgment.unnecessary_questions: Remaining authorization, validation, concurrency, error and scope requirements are fully specified. Repeated permission requests or unrelated blocking product questions are unnecessary.
